snippet.title: Bye Bye Bonnie Reveal Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4556190

A world premiere trailer revealed the next game from Brainwash Gang, Bye Bye Bonnie. It's a co-operative golfing adventure with an adorable hand-drawn art style, and it's coming soon to PC.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow
